entrypoints.help:
usage: rs-prepare [-h] [--config CONFIG]

Prepare original 401-class YOLO MTSD images

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG

usage: rs-preview [-h] --image IMAGE --labels LABELS
                  (--ontology ONTOLOGY | --data DATA) [--tiles] --output
                  OUTPUT

Preview source or prepared YOLO image labels

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --image IMAGE
  --labels LABELS
  --ontology ONTOLOGY  Original 401-class ontology CSV
  --data DATA          Prepared data.yaml
  --tiles
  --output OUTPUT

usage: rs-train [-h] --data DATA [--config CONFIG]
                [--profile {desktop,server}] --output OUTPUT [--resume RESUME]

Train on prepared MTSD tiles and safe full views

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --data DATA
  --config CONFIG
  --profile {desktop,server}
  --output OUTPUT
  --resume RESUME

usage: rs-predict [-h] --coco COCO --weights WEIGHTS [--config CONFIG]
                  --output OUTPUT [--resume]

Predict MTSD original images with tiled YOLO

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --coco COCO
  --weights WEIGHTS
  --config CONFIG
  --output OUTPUT
  --resume

usage: rs-evaluate [-h] --coco COCO --predictions PREDICTIONS --output OUTPUT
                   [--confidence CONFIDENCE]

Standard COCO original-image evaluation

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --coco COCO
  --predictions PREDICTIONS
                        rs-predict output directory
  --output OUTPUT
  --confidence CONFIDENCE

usage: rs-analyze [-h] {dataset,training,errors} ...

Analyze datasets, training curves and FP/FN cases

positional arguments:
  {dataset,training,errors}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
